survey: A single cowboy boot in side profile, toe pointing right, floating on a radial orange background with no ground drawn. The tall shaft leans slightly left and widens toward the top. Its outer side faces the camera straight on, so the raised leaf stitching is drawn front-on, which fits. A thin collar band wraps the ankle where the shaft meets the foot, slanting gently across the boot like a ring seen from slightly above. The foot runs to a squared toe that turns up a little (normal toe spring). Underneath is a thin dark sole, and at the back a raked block heel whose back face shows a little, which fits a camera slightly behind and above the boot. The gold spur sits at the heel counter: the arm sticks back and the star rowel is face-on, which is right because the rowel spins in a plane parallel to the boot's side. The shaft opening at the top is seen from slightly above. Overall the camera is about eye level, a little above and behind the boot, and the parts mostly agree.

errors.what: The opening does not read as one ellipse seen from slightly above. Only a sliver of the inside shows at the top right, and the front-left half of the rim curves outward like a closed, domed cap. The rim should show the near edge, the far edge and some inside all the way round, at the same slight top-down angle as the rest of the boot.

fix: Draw the boot's top opening as a continuous oval rim seen from slightly above. Show the dark inside of the shaft across the whole opening, with the near (front) lip lower than the far lip and the cowboy-boot scallop dips on both sides. No domed or closed top.
